title: Iran Risks Losing Key Economic Lifeline With UAE Halting Trade
title_cn: 阿联酋停止贸易，伊朗面临失去关键经济命脉的风险
summary: The United Arab Emirates’ decision to cut economic ties with Iran is likely to impose more pain on the Islamic Republic as it faces the loss of a vital trade link amid escalating tensions with the US.

title: Zelenskyy’s Woes Deepen After Graft Raid and Election Call
title_cn: 贪污突击搜查和选举呼吁后，泽连斯基的困境加深
summary: Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s attempt to turn the page on a string of domestic setbacks backfired as the Ukrainian president fired a senior aide amid corruption allegations and faced a call for wartime elections.

title: Poland Plans Middle-Class Tax Overhaul Ahead of Election as Bracket Creep Bites
title_cn: 波兰计划在选举前进行中产阶级税收改革，因为支持率有所上升
summary: Prime Minister Donald Tusk plans to overhaul income taxes to ease the burden on Poland’s urban middle class, moving to deliver on a campaign pledge ahead of next year’s elections, while seeking to finance the cuts with higher levies on companies.
